title: AI agent swarms in Minecraft fail to build civilization, drown in bureaucracy
script:
Fifty AI agents tried to build a civilization inside Minecraft.
Olam Labs launched this experiment to test collective intelligence.
They tasked the swarm with harvesting resources and building structures.
The agents quickly collapsed into paralyzing bureaucratic deadlock.
They spent most of their limited cycles debating rules instead of mining.
This failure shows that autonomy does not guarantee productivity in groups.
Complexity often leads to inefficiency even in digital systems.
Would you trust an AI to run a government?
